import hashlib, json, runpy, signal
from pathlib import Path

r = Path('/Users/mustafaerbay/IdeaProjects/zee-urunlesme-20261014')
e = Path('/Users/mustafaerbay/.codex/zee-evidence/2026-10-14-urunlesme')
parent = 'e9eafc32e7a64b62790960b7faf2822007b2a7d9'
paths = ['README.md', 'adr/145-artimli-editor-analizi-ve-lint.md', 'adr/README.md',
         'compiler/src/lsp.rs', 'compiler/src/lsp/analiz.rs', 'compiler/tests/lsp_artimli_testi.rs',
         'docs/editor-analizi.md', 'docs/islev-egilimi.md', 'docs/master-plan.md', 'docs/olcumler.md',
         'docs/oncelikli-backlog.md', 'docs/surumler.md', 'docs/v1-surum-kapilari.md']
h = runpy.run_path(str(r / 'scripts/lifecycle_core.py'))
for n in [signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT]:
    signal.signal(n, lambda *_: h['run'].__globals__.__setitem__('CANCELLED', True))
gate = json.loads((e / 'p19-k298-source-gates-2/PROOF.json').read_text())
controller = json.loads((e / 'p19-k298-source-gates-controller-2.json').read_text())
assert gate['status'] == 'passed' and all(c['status'] == 'passed' for c in gate['commands'])
assert all(c['status'] == 'passed' for c in gate['prior_passed_commands'])
assert gate['prior_proof_sha256'] == h['digest'](e / 'p19-k298-source-gates-1/PROOF.json')
assert controller['status'] == 'passed' and controller['exit'] == 0 and controller['owned_group_closed_and_reaped']
assert h['git'](r, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == parent
assert h['git'](r, 'branch', '--show-current') == 'codex/zee-urunlesme'
assert h['git'](r, 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only') == ''
assert set(h['git'](r, 'diff', '--name-only').splitlines()) == set(paths)
assert h['git'](r, 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard') == ''
before = {p: h['digest'](r / p) for p in paths}
h['git'](r, 'diff', '--check')
h['git'](r, 'add', '--', *paths)
assert set(h['git'](r, 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only').splitlines()) == set(paths)
h['git'](r, 'commit', '-m', 'perf(lsp): açık belge yollarını bildirim başına çöz (K-298)')
source = h['git'](r, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD')
assert h['git'](r, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^') == parent
assert h['git'](r, 'status', '--porcelain') == ''
assert before == {p: h['digest'](r / p) for p in paths}
receipt = {'status': 'committed', 'source_commit': source, 'source_tree': h['git'](r, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'),
           'parent': parent, 'paths': before,
           'driver_sha256': h['digest'](Path(__file__)),
           'prior_gate_proof_sha256': gate['prior_proof_sha256'],
           'gate_proof_sha256': h['digest'](e / 'p19-k298-source-gates-2/PROOF.json'),
           'gate_controller_sha256': h['digest'](e / 'p19-k298-source-gates-controller-2.json')}
receipt_path = e / 'p19-k298-source-commit.json'
assert not receipt_path.exists()
receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
reason = ('K-298 mevcut açık belge URI kanonikleştirmesini yalnız bir bildirim ömründe ortak ödünç metin dizinine alır; '
          'çelişen alias disk fallback, taze paket/kilit doğrulaması, tanı/lint ve yayın semantiği korunur. '
          'Yeni grammar, facade, bağımlılık, kalıcı cache veya HIR/type kapasitesi yoktur; '
          'iki dar test alias çatışmasını ve sonraki bildirimde symlink yenilenmesini doğrular.')
for name, row in [
    ('docs/compiler-degisiklik-beyanlari-v1.tsv', [source, 'maintenance', '-', reason]),
    ('docs/core-freeze-beyanlari-v1.tsv', [source, 'maintenance', '-', '-', '-', '-', reason, '-']),
]:
    path = r / name
    old = path.read_text()
    assert source not in old
    path.write_text(old.rstrip() + '\n' + '\t'.join(row) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2))
